english.title: Cyclist holding vehicle for purpose of being drawn
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), for the purpose of being drawn,

(A)_[took]_
(B)_[retained]_

hold of a vehicle in motion on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section26(2) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road TrafficOffenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being pedal cyclist took/retained hold of vehicle
in motion on a road for purpose of being drawn

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Section 26(2) applies to any person (not just pedal cyclists) taking hold of a vehicle - see offence wordings H3014 and H3015.
(ii) See also offence wording: H2513.
(iii) This offence is eligible for a Fixed Penalty under Part 3 of the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988 from the 24th February 2025 due to SI 2025/68.
english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant, who was riding a pedal cycle, held onto **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) while it was moving on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..).
